Four more full runs of the harness, after the runs of baseline.txt and trial.txt (2026-10-08, 01:11-01:33),
in the order dev, PR, PR, dev, each after the nominal thermal state and a 60 s rest, the same command as
there; meanwhile the process's memory was read every second with `top -l 1 -pid <pid> -stats mem,cmprs`
(MEM: its memory footprint, CMPRS: the part of it that is compressed). Not a speed measurement: the reads of
top run beside the harness. In run 3 the peak that /usr/bin/time reports is the plateau after the first prompt;
in runs 1, 2 and 4 no sample reaches it (5383, 5175, 5821 MiB against 5579, 5399, 6223 MiB): it lasted less
than a second. Only while the model loads do the samples rise and fall by more than 1 GB.

Each run: the seconds since the start of the run, then MEM/CMPRS as top prints them (M = 2^20 bytes), ten
samples a line; the harness's output, each line with its second; the end of its log with /usr/bin/time -l.
